scripts.build: pnpm run build:engine && pnpm run build:packages
scripts.build:engine: cd packages/engine && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$PWD=/workspace/dicee/packages/engine --remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/workspace/.cargo" wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../web/src/lib/wasm
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @dicee/shared build && pnpm --filter @dicee/simulation build && pnpm --filter @dicee/web build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:typescript && pnpm run check:analysis && pnpm run check:workers
scripts.check:rust: cd packages/engine && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo fmt --check && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check:typescript: pnpm --filter @dicee/shared build && pnpm --filter @dicee/simulation typecheck && pnpm --filter @dicee/web check && pnpm --filter @dicee/cloudflare-do typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:do && pnpm run test:simulation && pnpm run test:analysis
scripts.test:agent: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm --filter @dicee/web test:agent && pnpm --filter @dicee/cloudflare-do test:agent && pnpm --filter @dicee/simulation test:agent && pnpm run test:analysis
scripts.test:rust: cd packages/engine && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo test --all-features
scripts.test:analysis: uv run --project packages/analysis --group dev pytest -q packages/analysis
scripts.test:scripts: for t in scripts/tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$t" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:analysis: uv run --project packages/analysis --group dev mypy packages/analysis/src
scripts.lint:analysis: uv run --project packages/analysis --group dev ruff check packages/analysis
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run lint:analysis && pnpm run biome:check && pnpm run akg:verify && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.lint:rust: cd packages/engine && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.biome:check: pnpm --filter @dicee/web biome:check && pnpm --filter @dicee/cloudflare-do lint && pnpm --filter @dicee/simulation lint
scripts.format: pnpm run format:rust && pnpm run format:typescript
scripts.format:rust: cd packages/engine && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo fmt
scripts.format:typescript: pnpm --filter @dicee/web format && pnpm --filter @dicee/cloudflare-do format && pnpm --filter @dicee/simulation format
scripts.validate: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:agent && pnpm run build
scripts.validate:ci: pnpm run validate && pnpm run audit:dependencies && pnpm run security:public
scripts.toolchain:versions: node --version && pnpm --version && (cd packages/engine && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN rustc --version && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo --version) && python3 --version && uv --version && bun --version
scripts.db:types: test -n "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:-}" && supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" > packages/web/src/lib/types/database.ts
scripts.akg:verify: pnpm akg:check && pnpm akg:mermaid --check && pnpm akg:test
